description: Re-read an order intent created by create_order — the recorded basket and its honest status. Poll it after forwarding create_order's `handoff` note: it re-resolves each topic's payment link against the current registry, so a link still being minted shows up here when ready. Payment truth for checkout purchases lives with Stripe (the payer's receipt is authoritative); metered work is receipted on your meter account and readable via get_account.
name: get_order
